title: Leviticus — Instructions and Commands
content:
Leviticus — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

7 additional passage records · 7 quoted verse units. Read Leviticus in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Read this supplement together with the existing Torah requirements. Its narrower original count is preserved. 217 selected verse units already represented by that index are cross-referenced below instead of re-entered. Other thematic overlap still requires review.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Family, marriage and household · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Historical · 1 passage records

Leviticus 9:6

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Preparation on the Eighth Day.

Leviticus 9:6 — And Moses said: Do this thing which the Lord said, and the glory of the Lord shall appear among you.

Context and scope: A direction recorded in this narrative. Its original speaker, recipient and occasion must be retained; recording an order does not establish that God approves it or commands every believer to repeat it.

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: The Anointed Priest.

Record type: Historical direction. Source section: Nadab, Abihu, and Aaron’s Response.
